Name: PESO: Operational Services System for Ozamiz City
One-line summary: A web-based system that digitizes PESO Ozamiz City's job seeker enlistment, employer record-keeping, referral issuance, first-time jobseeker certification, and DOLE reporting for staff-operated use, with no applicant or employer accounts required.
Stack or issuer: Laravel (PHP backend framework), MySQL (database), HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Bootstrap (frontend styling/components).
